s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with urinary frequency, pelvic pain, and weight loss
salient_findings: Heterogeneous 9.4 cm lesion involving the right uterine fundus/cornua
Mass in the right retroperitoneal space, encasing the right external iliac artery
Tumor with fleshy solid and cystic components, central hemorrhage, and necrosis
key_facts: 54-year-old woman
History of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma
Treated with mastectomy and chemoradiation 4 years earlier
Presenting with urinary frequency
Worsening right-sided pelvic pain
Weight loss
MRI of the pelvis showed multiple fibroids
Mass involved the right uterine fundus/cornua
Mass was in the right retroperitoneal space
Mass encased the right external iliac artery
Tumor was detached, fragmented, and ill-defined
Tumor had fleshy solid and cystic components
Tumor had central hemorrhage and necrosis
High nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios
Frequent mitoses (32 per 10 high-power fields)
Pseudo-rosette formation
Foci of cytoplasmic clearing
Diffuse positivity for CD99, KIT, and cyclin D1

shortlist.label: High-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse positivity for CD99, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, and frequent mitoses

shortlist.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large pelvic mass with high-grade features and necrosis

shortlist.label: Ewing sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Small, round, hyperchromatic cells with pseudo-rosette formation and diffuse CD99 positivity

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Small, round, hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and foci of cytoplasmic clearing

shortlist.label: Metastatic breast carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma and presence of a large pelvic mass

raw.rationale: The tumor's location in the uterine fundus/cornua, involvement of the myometrium, and diffuse positivity for CD99 are consistent with high-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma. The presence of pseudo-rosette formation, foci of cytoplasmic clearing, and high mitotic activity also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of desmin and myogenin positivity, which are typical for leiomyosarcoma

rejected.label: Ewing sarcoma
rejected.why: Although CD99 positivity is seen in Ewing sarcoma, the tumor's morphology and location are not typical for this diagnosis

rejected.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
rejected.why: This tumor typically occurs in the abdominal cavity of young males and has a distinct desmoplastic stroma, which is not described in this case

rejected.label: Metastatic breast carcinoma
rejected.why: The tumor's morphology and immunohistochemical profile do not match the patient's history of breast carcinoma
